name: Fest Season

categories.label: Lineup (bands x genre volume VP)
categories.labelVi: Lineup (ban nhạc x điểm thể loại)
categories.hint: Per genre: VP at final volume x number of your bands in that genre; bands playing the same slot count once. Enter each genre subtotal.

categories.label: Tracks (lowest of amenities / attendance / ticket price)
categories.hint: Find your lowest token among the 3 tracks and read the VP in the right column.

categories.label: Objectives (VP above completed markers)
categories.labelVi: Mục tiêu (VP trên marker đã hoàn thành)
categories.hint: Sum VP shown above your completed objective markers, incl. end-of-game objectives ranked after the game.

categories.label: Venue (constructions VP)
categories.hint: Add the VP of every construction in your venue.

categories.label: Projects (farthest-right project column)
categories.hint: VP shown below the farthest-right project placed above your board.

categories.label: Stages (lineup boards VP)
categories.hint: VP of each lineup board by number of bands placed on it.

categories.label: Remaining money
categories.hint: 1 VP per 5 money left, rounded down. Enter remaining money.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends immediately when the master track fader reaches the top; collect income happens before moving the fader. Genre VP-per-band values depend on each genre's final volume (printed on board/scorepad) so lineup is entered as per-genre subtotals. Variants & Modules booklet and solo mode not modelled.
